title: Ramp explains an online-learning approach to faster, more reliable LLM routing
friendlyTitle: Ramp lets its AI gateway learn the best route
summary: Ramp describes using Thompson sampling with latency estimates in its LLM gateway to choose a fast, reliable route for each request. The routing policy learns from observed performance instead of relying on a fixed provider order.
friendlySummary: Ramp’s system watches how fast and reliable each AI route is, then learns which one to use for a new request.
whyItMatters: For teams using interchangeable model endpoints, routing can reduce latency and avoid unhealthy providers without changing the user-facing workflow. The broader lesson is to treat model delivery as a measured system that adapts to real traffic, not a static configuration.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make AI apps faster and more dependable when several providers can do the same job.
